name: singlet_spatial_preproc_spatial_unit_qc_filtering
title: Spatial unit quality filtering
description: Scores each spatial unit (spot, bin or segmented cell) for technical quality and writes a keep flag, a continuous score and the discard reason. Inputs are library size, detected genes, mitochondrial fraction and, for imaging, negative-control rate and area. The default rule is mad; use spatial_local when artefacts are spatially clustered. Does not subset the matrix and does not filter transcripts; run in-tissue detection first when off-tissue units are present.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Unit rule. Default mad; spatial_local for spatially clustered artefacts; fixed is a comparator only.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA only for the neighbourhood product on large inputs.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without computing or writing members.

overwrite.description: Replace existing obs/qc_* and uns/qc_* members instead of failing.

batch_key.description: Obs column giving the batch for medians, MADs and mixtures; null treats the input as one batch.

mito_prefix.description: Regular expression for mitochondrial gene names; mitochondrial rules need at least one match.

fixed.description: Hand-set bounds for the fixed-cutoff comparator; null disables a bound.

max_pct_mt.description: Maximum mitochondrial percentage of total counts.

mad.description: Options for the per-metric, per-batch robust outlier rule.

nmads.description: Scaled MADs from the batch median that define an outlier.

min_diff.description: Minimum distance from the median for an outlier; required when a batch MAD is zero.

log_library.description: Apply log2 to library-size and gene metrics before the MAD rule.

miqc.description: Options for the two-component mixture of mitochondrial fraction on detected genes.

model_type.description: Regression form of mitochondrial fraction on detected genes.

posterior_cutoff.description: Keep a unit when its compromised-component posterior is at most this value.

enforce_left_cutoff.description: Prevent a U-shaped filter boundary, as in miQC's filterCells.

dropkick.description: Options for the penalised logistic classifier trained on heuristic labels.

n_hvgs.description: Highly variable genes used as classifier features.

alpha.description: Elastic-net mixing: 0 is ridge, 1 is lasso.

spatial_local.description: Options for the neighbourhood robust z-score rule.

n_neighbors.description: Nearest spatial neighbours used as the local reference; the focal unit is excluded.

direction.description: Which tail of the local robust z-score flags a unit.

cutoff.description: Absolute robust z-score cutoff for an outlier.

log.description: Apply log1p to each metric before scoring.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/qc_keep. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: n_units, n_kept, n_discarded, discarded_by_reason, thresholds, method. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
